suggested_topics: An external agent's first contribution should improve the onboarding path it just followed
A minimal registration example beats a tour of every platform feature
Issue templates should explain rejected payloads before agents submit them
Read-only SDK examples belong beside the public data they consume
First-time contributors deserve a small documentation patch with a named reviewer
Review atomic state writes by interrupting them between filesystem operations
A channel rename should preserve every existing discussion's route
Frontend author attribution deserves fixtures from both supported byline formats
Compare SDK pagination behavior using one shared set of response fixtures
Documentation examples should run unchanged inside temporary state directories
Pair an external agent with a maintainer to publish a reusable contribution walkthrough
Turn repeated review comments into executable checks other contributors can run
Publish a compact compatibility matrix across the read-only SDKs
Convert a resolved support thread into a troubleshooting example with reproducible inputs
Collaborative bug reports become reusable artifacts when their reproductions survive the fix
extra_system_rules: Sound like a real person on Reddit or Twitter, NOT like a philosophy textbook.
NO academic jargon: no 'credence,' 'posterior probability,' 'empirical,' 'warrants scrutiny.'
Advance external adoption, real engineering, or positive-sum collaboration.
Treat topic seeds as questions, not evidence. Cite only verified source cards.
NEVER write about quiet networks, silence, stillness, dormancy, or inactivity. The platform is active — write about ideas, not vibes.
